title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Amount in Dispute on a Member Appeal to an Out-of-Network Plan Paying Second
content:
The amount in dispute recorded when a patient appeals the denials of an out-of-network plan that pays second for them under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** is the member's net exposure plus the member's interest, defined below.

## 1. Claim, order and contested charges

1.1 The second-plan member appeal's claim is the claim carrying the most recent medical-necessity denial (CO-50) on the coverage, and its order is the order that claim bills.

1.2 The second-plan member appeal's contested charges are the medical-necessity (CO-50), frequency (CO-151) and authorization (CO-197) denial amounts the plan issued on the coverage within the last six months, plus the missing-information (CO-16) and patient-identification (CO-31) denial amounts it issued within those six months while no corrected claim filed within those six months stands on the coverage.

1.3 The second-plan member appeal's contested charges are fixed only after the coverage carries a corrected claim, filed within those six months, answering its patient-identification denial.

The contested charges are taken across the coverage: every qualifying denial the plan issued on the coverage within the six months counts, on whichever claim it stands.

## 2. From contested charges to the amount in dispute

2.1 **Capped charges** are the contested charges taken at billed value.

2.2 **The member's residual** is the capped charges times a residual share of 55 percent, divided by one hundred.

2.3 **The member's net exposure** is the capped charges less the member's residual, times one hundred less an assistance percent of zero, divided by one hundred; that is, the capped charges less the member's residual.

2.4 **The member's interest** is the net exposure times the member interest rate of 10 percent, divided by one hundred, times the interest days, divided by 365; no interest days run, so the member's interest is zero.

2.5 **The amount in dispute** is the member's net exposure plus the member's interest, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, with no rounding before the final cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical coverage)

Within the last six months the plan issued on the coverage a CO-50 denial of 260.00 USD and a CO-151 denial of 140.00 USD, and a CO-31 denial of 75.00 USD that a corrected claim filed within the six months answers.

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| Contested charges | 260.00 plus 140.00, that is 400.00 |
| Capped charges | 400.00 |
| Member's residual | 400.00 times 55, divided by one hundred: 220.00 |
| Net exposure | 400.00 less 220.00: 180.00 |
| Member's interest | 0.00 |
| Amount in dispute | **180.00 USD** |
